snippet.title: DreamCatcher: Reflections (Visual Novel Trailer)
snippet.description:
Welcome to your OTHER reality.

DreamCatcher: Reflections is a fantasy adventure kinetic novel series about growing up, and maybe also saving the world.

OFFICIAL WEBSITE: https://www.dreamcatcherreflections.com/
GET VOLUME 1 (Chapters 1-5) HERE: https://hazumirein.itch.io/dreamcatcher-reflections-volume-1
-OR-
START WITH THE BETA VERSION OF CHAPTER 1 HERE (FREE!!!): https://hazumirein.itch.io/dreamcatcher-reflections-chapter-1

Follow me on Twitter for updates!: https://twitter.com/SkelebunStudios

Music by Nice Wizard: https://soundcloud.com/nicewizard
Voiceover by MultiKnights: https://twitter.com/MultiKnights
